title: 湛虚翠轩 Zhanxu Cuixuan
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.45 m, eave 3.2 m, ridge 6.21 m above the ground
gable 硬山 or 悬山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 若帆之阁
evidence.excerpt_zh: 北逺山村東北度石橋折而西為湛虛翠軒又西為耕雲堂又西為若帆之閣湛虛翠軒東數十武有闗帝廟（圓明園册）臣等謹按若帆之閣下層額曰御風泠然上額曰平臨天境與湛虛翠軒諸額皆御書
evidence.summary: North-east of 北逺山村 over a stone bridge and west: 湛虛翠軒, 耕雲堂, the two-storey 若帆之閣 with a plaque per floor, and a 闗帝廟 a little to the east.

evidence.title: 题湛虚翠轩
evidence.locator: v3 p.182, under 若帆之阁; source ref 8-817
evidence.excerpt_zh: 四面窗棂弗纸糊，网轩了可隔翔乌。光明通彻内还外，顾盼真教有若无。却暑袖招凉籁拂，延清襟惹绿阴铺。一泓碧水阶前俯，心所澄然得似乎。
evidence.summary: Poem 题湛虚翠轩 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 若帆之阁.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01) with no label, 3x1 cells: a building stood here, its name unknown.
